model: Unchanged shared probability table P with every nonzero fixed Fourier class moment bounded in operator and nuclear norms. Old endpoint budgets are retained. shape_k uses R=min(V,sqrt(k V)) and B=V sqrt(ceil(V/k)), k=2,3. These are fixed upper bounds determined by V and the candidate only; no learned rank, task operator, label-dependent budget, arithmetic feature, or factor product. The common domain is the convex hull of these four probability-table families.
solver: Import the Schatten solver, gradients, projections, full-vocabulary ordinary CE, saved state, Fourier code and data unchanged from deef98cb. Full uses the full sum-CE gradient; minibatches refresh retained per-observation gradients with original batches, tails and shuffle, not unbiased SGD; forward retains one-hot observations and solves feasibility without training derivatives. No finite-step convergence theorem.
evaluation: Original frozen input, split hashes, complete-split metrics and cadence; stop only at the scheduled positive update satisfying ideal training CE within 1e-8 or the cap. First 99% held-out crossing is recorded but never stops training. Save and replay all 72 candidates, including failures. All 18 choices use training CE only: first ideal certificate in frozen order, else minimum CE without a certificate. Keep all candidate costs, then evaluate all splits.
interpretation: Lean CM9 first proves an actual intermediate-rank moment is excluded by both endpoint budgets and by their spectral convex hull. Additional fixed budgets preserve CM5/CM7 convexity and CE certificates. This follow-up was designed after endpoint failures were observed in the independently frozen all35 v1 cohort; it is not a prospective claim for those previously seen tasks. The first three tasks are failure diagnostics, the last three retain old success controls. No budget or checkpoint is selected using held-out accuracy. The original all35 run stays unchanged; this pilot does not establish all35 success or a matched transformer comparison. Inclusion alone is not missing-label recovery. All generated outputs stay ignored and local.
